FN-YMEJS22-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 177
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/30/2026
Senate Bill 177 as introduced would require certain health benefit plans that provide coverage
for a supplemental or diagnostic breast examination to not impose any cost-sharing requirements
on enrollees, which would increase the costs of the State Employees' Health Insurance Plan
(SEHIP) and the Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP) by an
undetermined amount dependent on: (1) if molecular breast imaging is required to be covered,
(2) The increase in the number of breast examinations required to be covered due to family
history, and (3) if out-of-network services will be covered by this bill.
